ideas.title: Uncovering Childcare Fraud in the US
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of childcare fraud across the US, including the Minnesota Somali fraud case
ideas.angle: Follow the money and government agencies
questions: What is the full extent of childcare fraud in the US?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale pattern of fraud, with significant financial and social implications. By following the money and investigating government agencies, we may be able to expose a deeper issue.
